title: Theme editor framework: dial registry, schema 2 manifests and ThemeControls
detail: Plan steps 1, 2 and 4: dials.json and typed accessors, SiteStyle look keys (register, type, motion, hero, image, centered header, accent) stored sparsely so every existing site reads back identically, manifest schema 2 with schema 1 still valid, and the generic ThemeControls (Simple bar, Advanced sheet, Looks). Services is the first theme on it; converting the other themes (plan step 9) is separate rows.
